title: Storm Golem boss fight
summary: A boss mod with a command, boss bar, timed slam that launches the player, a second phase, and a textured drop with its own effect.
prompt: Add a Storm Golem boss. Typing /stormgolem summons it about 8 blocks in front of you, with a purple boss bar named "Storm Golem" that tracks its health. It has 200 health. Every 5 seconds it slams the ground and launches every player within 6 blocks into the air. Below half health it enters phase two: the boss bar turns red and it slams every 3 seconds. When it dies it drops a Storm Core, a custom item with its own texture. Right-clicking the Storm Core uses it up and gives you Jump Boost II for 10 seconds.

checks.title: /stormgolem summons a 200-health boss in front of the player
checks.steps: Run the checks in this order on ONE boss and do not call reset_arena between them. chat "/stormgolem", wait_ticks 20, then nearby_entities with radius 16.
checks.expect: A new non-player mob appears 5 to 12 blocks from the bot with health above 150 (200 expected). Its customName or the server log names it Storm Golem.

checks.title: A purple Storm Golem boss bar tracks its health
checks.expect: A boss bar whose title contains "Storm Golem", with color purple and health above 0.9.

checks.title: The slam launches a nearby player into the air
checks.steps: move_to the boss with range 3 (do not attack it), then track_self for 140 ticks.
checks.expect: track_self reports at least 1 launch and maxUpwardVelocity of at least 0.8 (a normal jump is 0.42). The server log shows a slam.

checks.title: Players farther than 6 blocks are not launched
checks.steps: Walk with move_to to a point at least 12 blocks from the boss (on the far side of the arena center, within 15 blocks of 0,65,0), check the distance with nearby_entities, then track_self for 140 ticks.
checks.expect: track_self reports 0 launches and maxUpwardVelocity below 0.5 while the server log shows the boss kept slamming.

checks.title: Below half health the boss bar turns red
checks.steps: game_setup: "data merge entity @e[type=!player,type=!item,distance=..24,sort=nearest,limit=1] {Health:106f}". equip netherite_sword, attack the boss once, wait_ticks 60, then boss_bars.
checks.expect: The Storm Golem boss bar is red with health below 0.5, and the server log mentions the second phase.

checks.title: In phase two the slam repeats every 3 seconds
checks.steps: move_to the boss with range 3, then track_self for 150 ticks. If it reports fewer than 2 launches (the bot was pushed out of range), move_to the boss again and repeat once.
checks.expect: At least 2 launches in one track_self call, and consecutive launchTicks are at most 75 ticks apart (about 3 s; phase one would be 100 ticks).

checks.title: The boss drops a textured Storm Core
checks.steps: game_setup: "kill @e[type=!player,type=!item,distance=..30]". wait_ticks 20, nearby_entities with radius 20 to find the dropped item whose item.customName contains Storm Core, move_to it to pick it up, then bot_state.
checks.expect: The inventory holds an item whose customName contains "Storm Core" and whose itemModel is outside the minecraft namespace (for example benana:storm_core). After the boss died, boss_bars no longer lists the Storm Golem bar.

checks.title: Right-clicking the Storm Core gives Jump Boost II and consumes it
checks.steps: equip the Storm Core (its material name is in bot_state), use_item with no target, bot_state, then move with jump true for 12 ticks.
checks.expect: bot_state lists a jump boost effect at level 2 lasting about 10 s, the Storm Core count dropped by one, and move reports maxHeightGain above 2.0 (a normal jump is about 1.25; level I is about 1.8).
